genius.licensingRegulator: UAF (Unidad de Analisis Financiero, Panama; AML/CFT reporting only)
genius.notes: XAUH is a physical-gold commodity token backed 1:1 by one gram of Swiss-vaulted fine gold and issued by Herculis Tokens S.A. in Panama. Because its reference value tracks gold rather than a fixed amount of national currency, GENIUS Act payment-stablecoin authorization is not applicable. Panama UAF reporting is an AML/CFT obligation rather than a prudential Swiss FINMA or U.S. banking license.
